exendin4.name: Exendin-4
exendin4.note: First deposited NMR conformer, measured in 30% trifluoroethanol. The conformation is condition-dependent and is not a receptor-bound pose. The deposited 1JRJ model includes a terminal OXT atom; mature exendin-4/exenatide is C-terminally amidated. Treat this as an experimental backbone reference, not an atom-for-atom drug formulation.
exendin4.bondNote: Bonds inferred from covalent distances for visualization; hydrogen atoms omitted.
modifications: C-terminal amidation in mature exendin-4 / exenatide; residue sequence has 39 amino acids.
